description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Yogurt, Butter etc. (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory measures (tax rates on specific commodities) and references to legal instruments (rescinding previous orders). The mention of Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe is incidental to the regulatory action and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his title, making this primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
